r0_observation.v1_exec_observation: The observed V1 parent gate requests and evaluates ExecStart but does not request or evaluate ExecStartEx.
r0_observation.systemd_semantics: systemd special Exec command prefixes are represented as extended command flags; '+' maps to the privileged command flag, and non-empty extended flags can alter execution semantics even when the executable path is unchanged.
r0_observation.parallel_composition_debt: Independent current candidates also cover path-chain integrity, loader-environment/global-preload controls, release artifact identity, and stale/sibling launcher identity. PR #479 does not claim to compose all of them.

grf.generated_reality: A direct absolute ExecStart pointing to the admitted launcher plus non-root User= is sufficient to characterize the productive systemd parent execution semantics.
grf.counter_reality: The same visible ExecStart path can carry special-prefix semantics represented only in ExecStartEx.flags, changing privilege/sandbox behavior while remaining invisible to the V1 predicate.
grf.falsifier: Hold all V1 snapshot fields constant and add a flag-bearing ExecStartEx observation; admission must change if extended command semantics are actually bound.
